reviews.text:

I will be replacing this device.

The next recording was of me coming home. There were no other videos of people coming up to either of our houses but there were a few recordings of cars going by or people walking on the opposite side of the street.

The video quality is good and the sound is pretty good as well but I need it to record all activity in front of my house.

I have other devices in my home I do not pay subscriptions for, just use an SD card and have access to all features without a subscription, and I am looking at replacing these two devices with devices from that company. reviews.title: works well but what’s the point if it constantly logs you out and deletes all footage?
reviews.text: the app constantly logs you out for “inactivity” (for not opening the app in a while). when it logs you out, it deletes all of your footage. it gives no warnings that it’s about to log you out. this is frustrating because if you don’t have people coming to your door constantly, then you have no reason to open the app, especially because it tells you through a notification that someone is at your door so you don’t have to open the app every time. However, on the rate occasion that someone steals a package, tries to come in your door, etc. and you need to check the footage to see who it was, it’s useless because the app will have logged you out and deleted the footage already, so it won’t be accessible. so what’s the point of recording??

reviews.title: Pay-Per-View Forced Access
reviews.text: This little camera was under $20 to purchase which was an excellent value for a description that was advertised as “Video Door Camera-NO SUBSCRIPTION NEEDED.” Worked as described for 6 months with a clear, colored view of person at my doorstep. Later came the annoying Ads, which I was able to tolerate. I would watch 2-3 of them to get quick view of person at my front door when door cam was rung. FF one year later and this camera has become useless! I can no longer view or, see anything without a PAID subscription. I purchased this door camera because it clearly “advertised” and said “No subscription needed.” Well with all the APP updates and a year of use without paying for a subscription camera becomes useless. I purchased a Wyze with my own memory chip and no subscription needed. Currently I don’t have to pay for anything to view who’s outside my door. Hopefully, it will stay that way since Apps are always updating with changes? If my Wyze camera becomes a pay-per-view camera! I will just go old school and start looking out my window or, use my strong voice and ask “Who is it?!?” Don’t be duped! Finally I can relieve my devices of this trash. Aiwit gets access to sell/use my information when I purchased and downloaded app! Greedy corporation’s need to stop abusing consumer’s ! Read about how to STOP them in “The SEPARATION of CORPORATION and STATE” by Lebo Von LoDebar!

reviews.title: Weak-battery cameras!
reviews.text: While the app is just okay, the hardware it tries to support is just plain inferior and cheap. The image quality is good, but everything else concerning maintaining operation of their system is substandard, IMO. I am constantly recharging batteries! Additionally, while all four of my cameras were purchased on “the Big A,” that retailing giant will not allow any reviews of the hardware — that’s how iffy the cameras are and how plentiful the complaints have been. One can assume the merchant has not been forthcoming about the battery problem or willing to do anything about it. Something to think about! I’m looking to replace them with solar-powered units that offer 60 days of free on-board storage, without any annual fee per camera. Think about it!

reviews.title: Horrible.
reviews.text: Absolutely ridiculous to pay a subscription to watch live views!

One camera stopped working early on and I had to get another one. Once I got the new one, they tried to charge me for a brand new year subscription instead of just adding the new camera to the existing subscription. That was like pulling Hair to get my refund.  even if you set them to capture most things they don’t. It’s like the person has to literally walk up and rang the doorbell. Instead of it catching motion when you set it to pick up from further away. Also, customer service is horrible at responding when there’s an issue. I bought three separate cameras and paid for them to auto renew every year. For two cameras, my subscription is not over until April of this year. One of the cameras they have cut off my Cloud service in February. I have been arguing with them since then and I have shown proof that the Subscription is still active, and they still will not turn my cloud back on, essentially stealing my money. The one that doesn’t expire until next December camera just stopped working out of nowhere. I bought brand new rechargeable batteries, and it still will not work. I also don’t like the fact that I can’t speak to a real person and I have to wait sometimes a week to speak to someone via chat. I know the price is cheap but you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: Do NOT waste your cash on any device that uses Aiwit. They change conditions and usability downwards at regular intervals. Oh and if you do, you’ll regularly need to log back into the app. Buy Tapo, you will not regret it.

reviews.title: Great Paperweight!
reviews.text:
I originally bought this doorbell a couple of years ago when we were having antisocial problems, and it was exactly what we were advised to get. 

At the time of purchase, I did purchase a years subscription, this was in case anything happened, but it also had the option to do a free version, which I ended up doing post cancellation. I’d happily watch a couple of adverts, and you’d get that day free, which I didn’t mind doing. 

Then all of a sudden, around 3 weeks ago (end of January), overnight the app signed me out, I signed back in and was presented with a pop-up telling me “get 3 days free and then you’ll be charged £29.99”!!, with no option to do a lite or a free version.

I have now found a doorbell that works without subscription.

In my opinion, the doorbell worked brilliantly for what we needed it for, it had a great picture and the volume was perfect and I’d quite happily give it a 5 star rating, but sadly I can only give one star because it’s nothing more than a paperweight to me!

reviews.title: Now charges for live view
reviews.text: I’ve had this app and doorbell for several years now, and have always been able to use live view. Now, however, it’s been put behind a paywall so you have to subscribe to the cloud services before you can access it.

reviews.title: Was Great for a while
reviews.text: It was great for a while. I didnt love the ads but it was cool that you could watch a few to get free space for a couple days. But then, all of a sudden, I could no longer see who was at my door. You now have to pay for a subscription to see anything. Which means I get a bunch of alerts that there’s movement but can not see who’s out there unless I pay for the subscription. Watching ads isn’t even an option anymore. No warning, just shut down access. The “chat” function in the app also never works so I can’t even consult anyone on the matter. I’m likely going to switch cameras but wanted to share.

reviews.title: Screw you in the end
reviews.text: I’ve had these cameras for a year and their good cameras sometimes they glitch but that’s the WiFi. What I don’t like about them is the adds that you have to exit out before you can look at the cameras and then on one of my new cameras which is solar paneled that one I now have to pay for in order to see through the camera in which at that point I rather by better quality cameras because these are get what you paid for basis. I did also- try to get in contact via email and chat message as that is an option on the app did not hear back from anyone. (Screw you in the end) well ima make sure everyone knows.

reviews.title: Keeps getting worse
reviews.text: Had no complaints the first couple years. I have 2 doorbell cameras and received a free light bulb camera with purchase. About a year ago ads starting popping up every single time I opened the app and sometimes again once I closed them and clicked to view a camera. Often times pushing a subscription I had already been paying for. Then a couple weeks ago when trying to check on my 2 year old on the lightbulb camera I was forced to get a subscription just to use it at all and access live viewing, which had logically been free since having the camera. So now it seems there is no way to use their products at all unless you pay 30 a year for each product. Even just to LIVE VIEW. Needless to say I will be finding a new less greedy camera company.

reviews.title: NOT WORTH YOUR MONEY
reviews.text:
Why are we being forced to pay a subscription just to access the basic live view feature of a doorbell we’ve already purchased?

Live view was always a standard function, and now after a recent update, Aiwit has locked it behind a paid plan. It’s unacceptable to remove core features and then charge customers extra to use them.

Overall, Aiwit has been rubbish and extremely disappointing. We will be changing doorbells because of this.

reviews.title: Cheap garbage
reviews.text: I’ve had their camera on my door for almost 4 years now and it’s literally just for show! You have to pay to use the camera literally! You cannot live view anything, you cannot watch videos it records unless you pay for it so the camera is just sitting there at my door useless for show and nothing more! The video quality is horrible, at nighttime with the night vision on you literally cannot see anything it’s completely blurry unless you are standing 5 inches in front of the camera! I would never pay for such poor quality service… when I first got it it was at least free to look through it and respond to people who ring it at the door now you cannot do ANYTHING unless you pay. I have Eufy cameras all around my house it’s WAY WAY better than this stuff… I’m going to replace my Aiwit with a Eufy doorbell camera very soon! Do better Aiwit

reviews.title: Not paying a subscription for “live view”!
reviews.text: The camera and app work just fine. Have had three cameras mounted on my home for the past year and a half. I paid the subscription on the most important camera, the front door, so that I would have a video recordings. I only wanted the other two cameras to have live view, without the need for video recordings. That system worked well for me until just recently, when they made a change to their system. Now I no longer have access to live views from the other two cameras. You now have to pay a subscription, just to see the live view of what the camera sees. So, in the trash you go! Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: I have been using the app with two cameras for some 18 months with no real issue. Recently, accessing the live view became a tedious evolution necessitating closing of a few adverts for the subscription service but now you have no choice, subscribe or lose access to your cameras. Total change of T&Cs for the cameras bought on understanding that a subscription is not required. Avoid this company at all costs unless you like to give money to unscrupulous and unethical businesses.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Update to app does not mention they will stop live views from being free. Having seen other security doorbell cameras this is the first to sneak subscription to live views. Having adverts is fine and giving customers option of advert or subscription would be best- this was the case for a few short 3 months. Now everything is subscription only even live view without warning in the update. Battery drains flat after 5 days in normal road including if not using (after 1yr). 20s to connect to live view despite modem right next to door. Would be great if all this could be improved

reviews.title: RATING CHANGE/ STOP TRYING TO CHARGE ME FOR SOMETHING I’VE CANCELLED!
reviews.text: I would’ve continued to give a 5 ⭐️ rating, but I canceled my subscription from renewing back in December, and for whatever reason they continue to try to build me. Therefore, I am unable to download apps or anything because they’re constantly trying to get $30 that I’m not paying. This device just isn’t for me because it dies too fast and where I live picks up a lot of traffic, causing the battery to continuously die. Perfect for an apartment building just not live. I would really appreciate to stop being billed for something that clearly says I canceled! There’s no Customer support,nothing and it’s just very frustrating!!

reviews.title: Customer no service
reviews.text: I have had this for a couple years with no problems ever until now. My device simply shut down and stopped working. It was still charged at 70% and just went offline. I reached out through the customer service chat. At first they asked was their power and I said no. Then they sent me a link to order a replacement so I submitted it but they stated that it would take 2 to 3 weeks. Next thing I know when I go back to check again it’s still the same repeat messages did you charge it is the power still on and I’m like I’ve answered these questions already and you sent the link saying that you were going to replace it when you go to look at it through the link it still says pending. No one has responded and the customer service in my opinion is trash so after that, I would never purchase this again. My problem was not resolved so now I have to buy another camera just not through them.

reviews.title: Useless.
reviews.text: Used it for years and now its unusable. Takes about 20 minutes to load live view, makes you watch ads to see who was just at your door, constantly says "device offline" or "device switching modes" any time you try to check it. Logs you out after a week so when someone does ring the doorbell it doesnt actually ring and you dont get notified. Cancelled my subscription and was still charged for it, customer service didnt respond so had to go through Apple to get money back.
